name: Uma Exports Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1988, Uma Exports Ltd 
trades Sugar, Spices, Food grains, tea, 
pulses and related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does trading and marketing of agricultural produce and commodities. It is a B2B trader with a specialization in sugar, corn, and dal. Company maintains stocks and distributes them to different institutional parties like manufacturers, exporters, etc. in bulk quantities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 25.9 to 19.4 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 21.7 days to 16.9 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 8.05% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.10.7 Cr.
